description: This file defines a report parser class for crossovered analytic reports in Odoo, including methods for retrieving and processing analytic account data and lines for reporting purposes.

classes.name: crossovered_analytic
classes.description: Report parser class for crossovered analytic reports, providing methods to gather and process analytic account data for reporting.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the report parser, setting up local context with helper functions and variables.

methods.name: find_children
methods.description: Recursively finds child analytic accounts related to given reference IDs.

methods.name: set_account
methods.description: Recursively reads account data and their child accounts to build a list of account IDs.

methods.name: _ref_lines
methods.description: Retrieves analytic lines related to a reference account within a date range and calculates totals.

methods.name: _lines
methods.description: Generates detailed analytic line data for specified account IDs, including percentages relative to total amounts.
